items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: But I got to know Kaiser after I came to New York.

ctx.x: In fact, the first time I heard Fletcher before I left home Kaiser Marshall was the drummer.
But I got to know Kaiser after I came to New York. He had left Fletcher but I still got to know him around New York because he still --
He was a nice quiet man, wasn't he?
